responsibility: Defines the SH machine-description patterns for atomic and synchronization operations. It implements the target’s __atomic and __sync style integer atomics across multiple SH execution models—hardware ll/sc on SH4A, gUSA and TCB rewindable software atomics, interrupt-mask software atomics, and optional tas.b test-and-set—providing the expanders, insn patterns, constraints, and ABI conventions needed to generate lock-free or fallback atomic RTL sequences on each SH variant.
